info.name: CoinGecko Crypto Market Data Asset Platforms Coins API

params.name: include_platform
params.description: Include platform contract addresses in the response (e.g., Ethereum, Solana contract addresses)

items.docs: Get the complete list of all supported coins with their IDs, symbols, and names. Use this endpoint to obtain coin IDs for use in other endpoints. This list is cached and updated periodically.

params.name: vs_currency
params.description: The target currency of market data (e.g., usd, eur, btc)

params.name: ids
params.description: Comma-separated list of coin IDs to filter results

params.name: category
params.description: Filter by coin category

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for results

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of results per page (1-250)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination

params.name: sparkline
params.description: Include sparkline 7-day price data

params.name: price_change_percentage
params.description: Comma-separated list of price change percentage timeframes (1h, 24h, 7d, 14d, 30d, 200d, 1y)

params.name: locale
params.description: Language locale for descriptions

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal precision for currency price values

items.docs: Get a paginated list of all supported coins with price, market cap, volume, and other market-related data. Results are ordered by market cap rank by default.

params.name: id
params.description: The CoinGecko coin ID (e.g., bitcoin, ethereum)

params.name: localization
params.description: Include all localized language descriptions

params.name: tickers
params.description: Include exchange tickers data

params.name: market_data
params.description: Include market data

params.name: community_data
params.description: Include community data

params.name: developer_data
params.description: Include developer data

params.name: sparkline
params.description: Include sparkline 7-day price data

items.docs: Get comprehensive data for a specific coin including current price, market data, community data, developer data, and more. This is the most detailed single-coin endpoint.

params.name: id
params.description: The CoinGecko coin ID (e.g., bitcoin, ethereum)

params.name: exchange_ids
params.description: Filter tickers by exchange IDs (comma-separated)

params.name: include_exchange_logo
params.description: Include exchange logo URL in the response

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for tickers

params.name: depth
params.description: Include order book depth (2% cost to move)

items.docs: Get trading pair tickers for a specific coin across all exchanges. Results include price, volume, spread, and trust score information.

params.name: id
params.description: The CoinGecko coin ID (e.g., bitcoin, ethereum)

params.name: date
params.description: The date of data snapshot in dd-mm-yyyy format

params.name: localization
params.description: Include all localized language descriptions

items.docs: Get historical data for a specific coin at a given date. Includes price, market cap, 24h volume, and community and developer data.

params.name: id
params.description: The CoinGecko coin ID (e.g., bitcoin, ethereum)

params.name: vs_currency
params.description: The target currency for market data

params.name: days
params.description: Number of days of historical data (1, 7, 14, 30, 90, 180, 365, or max for all available data)

params.name: interval
params.description: Data interval (daily). Leave empty for automatic granularity.

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal precision for currency price values

items.docs: Get historical market data including price, market cap, and 24h volume for a specific coin over a time range. Data granularity is automatic based on the number of days requested.

info.name: Get coin market chart data within date range

params.name: id

params.name: vs_currency
params.description: The target currency for market data

params.name: from
params.description: Start date as UNIX timestamp

items.docs: Get historical market data including price, market cap, and 24h volume for a specific coin within a custom date range specified by UNIX timestamps.

params.name: vs_currency
params.description: The target currency for OHLC data

params.name: days

params.name: precision
params.description: Decimal precision for currency price values

items.docs: Get OHLC (Open, High, Low, Close) candlestick data for a specific coin. Data granularity is automatic based on the number of days requested. 1-2 days returns 30-minute candles, 3-30 days returns 4-hour candles, and 31+ days returns daily candles.
Get the list of the latest 200 coins that have been recently added to CoinGecko. This endpoint is exclusive to paid plan subscribers.

params.name: duration
params.description: Time duration for price change calculation

params.name: top_coins
params.description: Filter by top N coins by market cap (e.g., 300 to only consider the top 300 coins)

items.docs: Get the top 30 coins with the largest price gain and the top 30 coins with the largest price loss over a specified time duration. This endpoint is exclusive to paid plan subscribers.
